WHAT: Multi-tutor calendar view for org admins at /company/calendar. Shows all sessions across all org tutors color-coded by tutor.

WHERE: src/pages/company/CompanyCalendar.tsx (new file), route added in App.tsx, nav link in CompanySidebar.tsx

HOW:
- Fetches tutor profiles via organization_admins join to find org tutors
- Fetches sessions for all those tutors
- Color-codes events by tutor_id
- Tutor filter dropdown to show all or specific tutor
- Week/month/day view

GOTCHA: Must add `scrollToTime={new Date(new Date().setHours(8, 0, 0, 0))}` prop — without it calendar starts at midnight and events are invisible even though data loads correctly.

VERIFIED: Browser tested with real seeded data — 11 sessions showing correctly across Monday-Thursday with student names and subject labels.
